description: This PHP test source file contains unit tests for the JobSpecificationAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It tests API endpoints related to job specifications, including getting a specific job specification and checks for unimplemented methods such as update, delete, and their validation rules.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAPITest
classes.description: This is a PHPUnit test class that extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase to verify the behavior of the JobSpecificationAPI endpoints, including testing retrieval of job specifications and ensuring certain methods throw not implemented exceptions.
